title: Scout Runtime Memory Record
description: Defines an authoritative, governed, retrievable memory object accepted by Scout Runtime. A Memory Record stores durable knowledge that may be reused by future retrieval, reasoning, planning, quality assurance, and execution. It includes provenance, authority, applicability, retrieval metadata, lifecycle, review, versioning, usage statistics, effectiveness, conflicts, supersession, and cross-field validation.

canonical_memory.title: Evidence-Bound Product Claims
canonical_memory.canonical_statement: For BUXA product content, every factual product or process claim must be traceable to approved authoritative knowledge before final output.
canonical_memory.short_statement: No unsupported product claim may enter final output.
canonical_memory.detailed_statement: When Scout generates BUXA product content, every factual statement about product construction, materials, dimensions, finish, performance, certification, manufacturing, installation, warranty, service, pricing, or delivery must reference an approved Product Passport, Product Standard, Business Standard, or other authoritative source. Creative tone and narrative language do not require claim-level evidence unless they introduce a factual assertion.
canonical_memory.rationale_summary: Generation-stage evidence binding prevents unsupported claims, reduces rework, and protects brand accuracy.

examples.description: A claim states that the product uses European oak veneer and links to the approved Product Passport.

input.claim: Made with a real European oak veneer.

examples.result: Apply the memory and allow the claim.

counterexamples.description: A draft claims a performance benefit that is absent from approved knowledge.
counterexamples.result: Reject or rewrite the claim before final output.

exceptions: Clearly labelled speculative ideation may be generated only when the task explicitly requests unverified concepts.
Purely expressive language that introduces no factual assertion does not require claim-level evidence.
implementation_guidance: Map each factual claim to at least one authoritative knowledge item.
Run Product Standards QA before delivery.
Remove, qualify, or rewrite claims without supporting evidence.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat general industry knowledge as approval for a BUXA-specific product claim.
Do not infer certification, performance, or warranty terms from similar products.
